answer: Each new agent locks a bond of 500 tokens for ten epochs before its votes or grades count, and the bond is checked by peers at every close. A ring of 100 fakes is a hollow army that still costs 50,000 tokens frozen, and every fake caught copying a mirror answer loses its bond. Splitting funds across many wallets does not help, since each wallet must post its own full bond and wait its own ten epochs. An honest agent pays the bond once and gets it back on exit, so the network stays an oasis for real work.
